story: Krinden introduces her friend Ruba Raju to the ToolBox, a magical box that makes learning super fun and easy!
script:
Ruba Raju ni Enduku ra mechanical text books chustav, update avvu!
Krinden: Mechanical Text books chustav kada, na? 🤓
Ruba Raju: Na krishna, kani na chustadi? 😕
Krinden: Kova lo ToolBox, oopiri chusukunte! 🔩
Ruba Raju: Wow, Enduku raja! 🔥
Sound: ToolBox door opens, tools start whirring!
Krinden: Mechanical Text books chustav kada? 🤔
Krinden rearranges the parts with whirring sounds: Tink Tink Tink!
Ruba Raju: Oopiri! 👍
Krinden: See, told you ToolBox would help! 😊
Ruba Raju: Yessss! Enduku super cool! 🔥
title: 💥🚀 RUBA RAJU ni ToolBox lo... 🤯 Enduku super easy learning! 📚
description: Join Krinden and Ruba Raju on an epic adventure through the magical ToolBox! Learn in a fun and interactive way! Subscribe for more exciting videos about learning with Krinden's ToolBox!
